title: Story premise ENT069: The Lost Star in the Dance
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: Follow the shoe, not the sparkle. Takeaway/theme: Use a stable identifier when positions keep changing.
description: A choreographer must find a star badge among five moving dancers, but rapid position swaps make guessing unreliable. They pause the formation at each beat and track the badge-bearing dancer by a distinct square shoe, then reveal that the star was always pinned on that dancer’s back.
